gloss: no days off; without a break; nonstop

definitions.gloss: no days off; without a break; working continuously without rest
definitions.explanation: The state of having no breaks, holidays, or rest days. Used to describe continuous work, operation, or effort without pause. Can describe a work schedule, a store's operating hours, or someone's relentless effort.

examples.japanese: {年中|ねんじゅう}{休|やす}みなしで{営業|えいぎょう}している。
examples.english: Open year-round without any days off.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{休|やす}みなしで{働|はたら}いた。
examples.english: I worked this entire month without a day off.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}り{前|まえ}は{休|やす}みなしで{準備|じゅんび}を{進|すす}めなければならなかった。
examples.english: Before the deadline, I had to keep preparing without any breaks.

notes:
Combines {休|やす}み (rest, break, day off) and なし (without, none). A straightforward compound using the common なし suffix.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年中|ねんじゅう}{休|やす}みなし: open year-round, no holidays
- {休|やす}みなしで{働|はたら}く: to work without days off
- {休|やす}みなし{営業|えいぎょう}: operating without days off
- {休|やす}みなしの{日々|ひび}: days without rest

USAGE:
Often seen on shop signs and advertisements to indicate that a store is open every day ({年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう} is the more formal equivalent). Also used to describe demanding work schedules or intense periods of effort. The tone can be matter-of-fact (describing a store's hours) or sympathetic/complaining (describing an exhausting workload).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}: open year-round — the formal, four-character equivalent
- {無休|むきゅう}: no holidays — more concise and formal
- {不休|ふきゅう}: without rest — literary, emphasizing tireless effort
